resharper_csharp_indent_invocation_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent method calls' parenthesis. Implemented. The four values set two numbers, contents and closing delimiter, in levels from the line the opener is on: none 0/0, inside 1/0, outside 1/1, outside_and_inside 2/1. Measured on a chopped call whose ) this export's wrap keys put on a line of its own; Skala and the oracle agree at all four values on constructs/indentation/delimiter-indent.cs.

resharper_csharp_indent_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent other parenthesis and brackets. Implemented, and not inert. ⚠ The previous entry recorded it measured-inert: "the oracle returns the file unchanged at inside, none and outside_and_inside". That was a fact about the probe. The M11 probe had no input where a delimiter this key governs lands on a line of its own, because nothing in this export's wrapping puts one there — but keep_user_linebreaks = true keeps one the author wrote, and arr[a + b\n] moves its ] in by one level at outside and outside_and_inside. ⚠ Skala now agrees at all four. SK-DIV-0041's shape — at none the stray ] took the ambient continuation instead of its opener's line level — was recorded as needing a zero-level scope kind the IR does not have; IndentKind.None was already declared in Doc.cs and had no call site. Zero levels meant no scope at all, and with no scope there was nothing for the closing delimiter to be aligned against. ⚠ An inertness claim was recorded here and withdrawn on 2026-08-30 when the key was implemented: previously read "the oracle returns the file unchanged at inside, none and outside_and_inside". Re-measured on an input where the delimiter reaches a line of its own — an author-written break before a ], which keep_user_linebreaks = true preserves — and all four values differ.

resharper_csharp_indent_primary_constructor_decl_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent primary constructor declarations' parenthesis. Implemented. ⚠ Its closer half is masked — wrap_before_primary_constructor_declaration_rpar = false keeps the ) on the last parameter's line — but its contents half is not: at none the oracle puts a record's parameters at the declaration's own column. ⚠ Skala now agrees at all four. SK-DIV-0043 is resolved and the second half of its own note was the answer: the outer of outside_and_inside's two levels belongs to the CLOSING delimiter, and wrap_before_primary_constructor_declaration_rpar = false means this ) is never a break point, so that level is never realised. ⚠ Not the closer takes a line — arr[a + b ] keeps its ] on a line of its own under keep_user_linebreaks and still gets one level. It is a configuration fact, not one only the fitter knows.

resharper_csharp_indent_statement_pars #

Parenthesis — Indent statement (if, while, for, etc) parenthesis. Read — ConditionLevels consults it — and inert under this export, which is a mask and not a gap: align_multiline_statement_conditions = true lays a condition and its ) out from an absolute column, and a level count has nothing to say about a column. All four values return the same file while that key is on; turn it off and the family's contents/closer table applies here like anywhere else.

resharper_csharp_indent_typeparam_angles #

Parenthesis — Indent type parameter's angles. Implemented, and not inert. ⚠ The earlier entry recorded it measured-inert on "a declaration with two type parameters and two constraints"; that file's > never reached a line of its own and neither did its contents wrap. On constructs/breaks/type-parameter-list.cs, whose list the oracle fills at its own commas, the continuation moves at every value: none 0, inside/outside 1, outside_and_inside 2. ⚠ Skala now agrees at all four. The outside_and_inside value was SK-DIV-0043's and is resolved with indent_primary_constructor_decl_pars: a > is never a break point, so outside_and_inside's outer level — which belongs to the closing delimiter — is never realised. ⚠ The key's closer half is separately out of reach: the shape is a > on a line of its own, and SK-DIV-0042 is that Skala rejoins the author's break before one where the oracle keeps it.

resharper_csharp_use_continuous_indent_inside_parens #

Whether the contents of a parenthesis take a continuation level. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6 with resharper_continuous_indent_multiplier = 2, which is the only configuration that can ask: M( at column 8 puts its arguments on 16 at true and on 12 at false. So false is one indent width rather than none. Under the export's own multiplier of 1 the two answers coincide and the key is unobservable. SK-DIV-0090.
